description: Drag CKC image into note: a CKC media asset (created via the managed POST /workspaces/{id}/loom/import asset-create path) is embedded as an hsLink node (refKind=HS_images) in a saved note; reload returns the node with the asset id. Routes verified 2026-06-26: there is NO bare POST /assets route; knowledge docs are merged bare (no /workspaces prefix) and save uses the /save suffix; create returns document.rich_document_id.

Drag CKC video into note: same as IC-01 with mime=video/mp4 (asset via POST /workspaces/{id}/loom/import); saved doc carries an hsLink node refKind=video. Routes corrected 2026-06-26 (no bare POST /assets; bare knowledge docs; /save suffix; document.rich_document_id).

Drag CKC moodboard card onto canvas: a typed ckc_moodboard Loom block is converted from the shared CKC DragPayload into a native CanvasDragPayload, persisted as a canvas placement, reloaded through GET board, and rendered by LoomCanvasBoard.

CKC character referenced in note: a typed ckc_character Loom block is linked from a persisted rich document; GET backlinks contains the note's block id and preserves the character identity without a generic-note fallback.

Route note selection to Stage pane: a text-range selection is routed via the SAME shared InteractionBus route-to-stage command into one StagePane; the production stage-routed-content node and the test-registered contract-literal alias stage.selection.preview both read the exact real StagePane summary, proving the literal id without a second model or fabricated selection state.

Open code block from note: clicking a [[code:symbol]] hsLink chip dispatches open-code-symbol on the SAME shared bus; the staged identity is selected by the shipped code-nav resolver, its typed definition span supplies the navigation line, and the real code panel caret lands there without a hard-coded navigate target.

Reference code symbol from note: the real Copy as note reference command writes [[code:...]] through the mockable clipboard and shared bus; inserting it yields hsLink(refKind=code), then the production native SaveManager persists it to managed SurrealDB, GET reload returns the exact refValue, and the exact save receipt records the code-prefixed reference target.

Shared find/replace across code and note: ONE shared InteractionBus Find dispatch invokes two mounted command subscribers exactly once; those subscribers drive the native CodeEditorPanel find state and Rich FindReplaceState with the same query. No post-dispatch direct test mutation supplies the result.

Code diagnostics surface note reference: a code diagnostic carrying a related-note reference dispatches open-document on the SAME shared bus; the rich-editor pane's real AccessKit surface ('rich-editor-surface') is the focus target. SUBSTRATE proof (no SurrealDB). Contract names 'rich_editor.pane.{doc_id}'; the REAL registered id is 'rich-editor-surface' -> assert the real id, typed note.

Backlink appears across surfaces: saving note A with a wikilink to code-block B registers a Loom backlink edge B<-A in managed SurrealDB; the proof reloads backend authority and verifies the exact source/target identities.

Loom Search v2 surfaces results from both editors: a note + a code-file block both containing XSEARCH_PROBE both appear in POST /loom/search-v2 hits; facets contain both content types. CTRL-6: poll the search endpoint up to 5x200ms (1s budget) before asserting (async indexing).

Graph view shows cross-surface edges: GET /workspaces/{id}/loom/graph/local?start_block_id=loom_A&max_depth=2 returns the exact persisted note/code nodes and KDLNK edge; the shipped LoomGraphView lays the exact live projection out at distinct positions and renders both persisted ids into the live AccessKit tree. There is no bare /loom/graph route.

AI Loom job proposes cross-surface link: a link_suggest AI job proposes a code-file target and acceptance writes a real backlink edge. The only allowed skip is the mounted endpoint's exact typed 409 HSK-409-LOOM-AI-NO-MODEL; before/after managed-SurrealDB proof requires zero owned-workspace suggestion rows, zero joined proposal events, and no delta in the fixture-owned session's AI proposal events. Every other response fails or passes normally.

Quick-switcher surfaces items from both editors: the quick-switcher's q-driven cross-surface query is served by GET /workspaces/{id}/loom/search?q=XSEARCH_PROBE (route corrected 2026-06-26: /loom/quick-switcher is recents-only with a limit param and NO q; the real q-route backing the quick-switcher is /loom/search). Returns entries from both the note (knowledge_rich_document) and the code block (code_file); each hit's block carries block_id, title, content_type, updated_at.

Undo crosses rich editor edit: EDIT_A is saved to managed SurrealDB, the canonical Ctrl+Z path runs through the ONE shared InteractionBus undo scope, the restored snapshot is saved, and a backend GET proves EDIT_A is absent while versions advance across both saves.

Undo crosses code editor edit: a code-buffer edit (insert CODE_EDIT) recorded on the ONE shared undo stack is reverted by one undo so the buffer no longer contains CODE_EDIT. SUBSTRATE proof (no SurrealDB) via the real CodeEditorPanel + push_code_edit_undo adapter. The SurrealDB version-revert half is requires_surrealdb.

Event-ledger records cross-surface actions: two persisted note saves produce ordered KNOWLEDGE_RICH_DOCUMENT_SAVED events read by exact rich-document aggregate identity; the second event payload carries the exact wikilink block reference and a missing aggregate returns no fabricated rows.

Shared undo stack policy scoped per-pane vs global: two panes (rich note A, code file B) are edited in sequence, then ONE undo reverts only the MOST RECENTLY edited surface (B), leaving A unchanged. CTRL-4: a single Arc<Mutex<UndoStack>> shared by both editors; the test inspects BOTH surfaces after one undo. SUBSTRATE proof (no SurrealDB), the load-bearing per-pane-scope policy proof.
